data.body_html:
Thinking about a Marbella boat charter in November 2042? You’re in for a treat. With mild 22°C days, calm seas, and far fewer tourists, November offers a uniquely peaceful way to experience the Costa del Sol from the water. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks — no hidden extras.

Why November 2042 Works for a Boat Charter

November is Marbella’s low season, which means quieter marinas, easier booking, and often lower rates. The sea temperature sits at a comfortable 18°C — still swimmable for many — and the air stays warm enough for sunbathing on deck. Average rainfall is minimal, with only 4–5 wet days for the month. You’ll enjoy around 6 hours of daily sunshine, perfect for a half-day or full-day excursion.

Our Fleet: Options for Every Group

All our boats are available year-round and depart from Puerto Banús. Here’s a quick overview:

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are ideal. For a party vibe, the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) or Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) deliver. Every charter includes skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA.

What to Expect: November Weather & Sea Conditions

In November 2042, expect average air temperatures of 22°C (high) and 14°C (low). Sea breezes are gentle, so the Mediterranean stays calm — ideal for guests prone to seasickness. The water clarity is often excellent after summer. You can comfortably anchor at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or cruise toward Estepona and Sotogrande.

Best Routes for a November Charter

Your skipper will recommend a route based on conditions, but popular November options include:

  • Puerto Banús to Cabopino — 20-minute cruise, calm coves, beachside dining.
  • Marbella coastline — views of La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile.
  • Estepona — 30–40 minutes west, colourful old town and quieter anchorages.
  • Sotogrande — 1 hour west, luxury marina and open sea vistas.

What to Wear & Bring

Pack a light jacket or sweater for the breeze, sunglasses, sunscreen, and swimwear if you plan to dip in the 18°C water. A thin wetsuit helps for longer swims. The boat provides all drinks and snacks, but you’re welcome to bring your own food (no glass, please).

Booking Tips for November 2042

While November is quieter, popular boats like the Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 Flybridge still get booked. Reserve at least two weeks ahead for the best choice. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) can be booked online; for all others, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. Check our Marbella boat charter hub for more inspiration.
